candidates.lead: The fortnightly tax table (ATO NAT 1006) sets the PAYG amount an employer withholds from each fortnight's pay in 2026-27. For $2,000 a fortnight with the tax-free threshold claimed, $276 is withheld [[calculatePAYGWithholding]], leaving $1,724 take-home. The table below lists the amount to withhold in $100 steps, with and without the threshold.

The ATO fortnightly tax table (NAT 1006) is the schedule of PAYG withholding amounts for employees paid every two weeks, applying to payments made from 1 July 2026 [[PAYG_FINANCIAL_YEAR]]. A $2,000 fortnight with the tax-free threshold claimed has $276 withheld [[calculatePAYGWithholding]]; without the threshold the amount is higher. Both NAT 1006 columns are reproduced below.

Fortnightly tax table 2026-27: the ATO's NAT 1006 schedule gives the tax to withhold from fortnightly earnings, worked out from the Schedule 1 formula with cents ignored. On $2,000 a fortnight the withholding is $276 with the tax-free threshold claimed [[calculatePAYGWithholding]], and it already includes the 2% Medicare levy with its low-income shading.
